name: Orisinal Collection
summary:
Step back into the world of Orisinal: Morning Sunshine — this timeless collection of charming mini games has captured hearts for twenty five years. Enjoy the original Orisinal mini games, lovingly presented for today’s devices. Compete with friends and players around the world. Track your progress, chase high scores, and see how you rank globally. Celebrate the spirit of Orisinal with a new game created especially for this collection. Collect apples, test your skills, and aim for the top of the leaderboard!
Whether you're reliving childhood favorites or discovering Orisinal for the first time, this collection is designed for quick bursts of joy and endless replay value.
